Aisha (People Ops): Quick heads-up — we’re launching a pilot called 'Transition Weeks' for people returning from parental or extended caregiver leave. The goal is to make the first 4 weeks back softer: reduced meeting load, optional part-time schedule, and a temporary 80% salary continuation option for the first 2 weeks if requested. 
Aisha (People Ops): Also added: a one-time travel reimbursement (up to $500) for reimbursing childcare/relocation travel when that return requires short-term travel. Reimbursement needs manager sign-off + receipts.
Marcus Chen: Love this. Who’s eligible? Full- and part-time employees? Global regions?
Aisha (People Ops): Eligibility: anyone on parental or caregiver leave who takes 4+ continuous weeks away. Applies to all regions where we operate. Part-time folks are eligible pro-rata.
Jen L.: HR Legal note — salary continuation option is a pilot and counts as taxable income per local law; we’ll run payroll flow with opt-in checkbox. Managers please route approvals to HR for audit.
Devon R.: Two quick questions: 1) If someone picks optional part-time for 4 weeks, do we adjust slack/meeting reminders automatically? 2) How do we request the travel reimbursement?
Aisha (People Ops): 1) We’ll push a calendar tag managers can apply: `Transition—Reduced` which will let people skip recurring all-hands invites. We’ll publish a tiny how-to. 2) Submit a Travel Reimbursement form (link below) + manager approval and receipts within 30 days.
Aisha (People Ops): Internal docs: https://intranet.redwood/careers/transition-weeks (pilot overview) and https://intranet.redwood/finance/travel-reimburse (reimbursement form).
OpsBot: Note — policy doc updated: `Transition Weeks v1.0` (approved by People Ops + HR Legal).
Marcus Chen: Timeline? When does pilot start and how long will it run?
Aisha (People Ops): Pilot start: Monday Apr 8. Recruitment for pilot cohort runs for 6 months; we’ll collect feedback and usage metrics and decide next steps in Q3.
Jen L.: Managers: please ensure you have written approvals on file. HR will send a template for manager acknowledgement.
Devon R.: Will engineering oncall coverage be impacted? We have some tight SLAs.
Aisha (People Ops): Good call — if an individual is on call, teams should agree an alternate primary for their oncall window. We’ll add guidance to the docs and ops teams should coordinate prior to leave return.
Aisha (People Ops): Action items: managers — check teams for upcoming returns and share this thread with affected folks. People returning — fill out the opt-in section on the leave exit form when you plan your return. Questions? Ping me or HR Legal. :wave:
HR Legal: Thanks — we’ll be available for any edge cases and will review cross-border tax implications as they arise.
